# function: elasticloadbalancing_listener_app

Builds the ARN of an `elasticloadbalancing` `listener/app`:

```
arn:${Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${Region}:${Account}:listener/app/${LoadBalancerName}/${LoadBalancerId}/${ListenerId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
elasticloadbalancing_listener_app(load_balancer_name string, load_balancer_id string, listener_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `load_balancer_name` (String) Value for `${LoadBalancerName}` in the ARN template.
1. `load_balancer_id` (String) Value for `${LoadBalancerId}` in the ARN template.
1. `listener_id` (String) Value for `${ListenerId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
